Fulltime candidates highly preferred.

Desc:
•    We are currently looking for an Informatica technical expert with following attributes:
•    Minimum of 5 years of Informatica PowerCenter hands-on experience in multiple large projects and minimum of 1 year experience in Informatica Cloud environments;
•    Worked with cloud application such as Salesforce.com, Oracle, Sql, flat complex files as source/target/transformation;
•    Ability to lead in ETL architecture, reusability components and best practice design efforts;
•    Intensive/ multiyear working experience in cloud space and principles i.e. loading high volume of data within SLA, proactive error handling;
•    Working knowledge of an enterprise level scheduling tool i.e. AutoSys

Soft skills:
•    Production support on rotation basis;
•    Working in a team comfortably which might be geographically diverse;
•    Working independently some time with limited existing documentation;
•    Financial industry background is not required, but a plus.

In addition to above Informatica requirement, we would like a candidate who can work on following:
•    Perl, Shell scripting, Oracle Dev, Salesforce apex dev,
•    Exposure to BO universe design and reporting
•    Programming background (any language)
